author: somegamerguy515
quote: First experience with GTA was GTAII on PS1. When the 3D trilogy dropped on PS2, it was a true game changer when it came to the open world, sandbox style genre. It was edgy, it was raw, and it was able to realize it was "just a videogame" at the end of the day. GTA IV was a massive leap in technology when it came to what the Xbox 360 and PS3 hardware were capable of. Liberty City was alive, the characters were likable, fun, at the same time dark and gritty. GTA V was good, but not the leap that GTA IV was in terms of pushing the game, and it started to lean into the mass appeal. VI? I'm sorry, R* has lost the plot. Insert girl boss, make the male 2nd place, sit in the passenger seat. Make him passive, submissive, weak. All the graphical fidelity in the world cannot hide the God awful writers behind this game. None of this is funny, none of it grabs you. Red Dead Redemption 2 was the last time that R* made great games. It's clear who has infested the studio, and who can't help but inject their feminist ideology into the story.  What a waste ****, but I cannot say I'm surprised. A whole lot of hype for a fart in the wind ****.
